verdict.rationale: AMD documents an official Ryzen AI Software stack that targets the NPU today: ONNX Runtime with the Vitis AI Execution Provider, OGA NPU-only and hybrid modes, Lemonade SDK, Quark quantization and the xrt-smi NPU management tool. However, the evidence pack contains no published NPU TOPS figure or stated precision for that figure, which is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: published NPU TOPS figure with stated precision (e.g. INT8), independent hands-on corroboration of NPU use on the 395.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the chip's AI acceleration is exposed to developers — an NPU or neural engine with a published TOPS figure (precision stated) and an official SDK or runtime that ships today

citations.quote: run them directly on laptops powered by Ryzen AI using ONNX Runtime and the Vitis™ AI Execution Provider (EP)
NPU-only and hybrid execution modes, which utilize both the NPU and integrated GPU (iGPU), are supported by ONNXRuntime GenAI (OGA).
The xrt-smi utility is a command-line interface to monitor and manage the NPU integrated AMD CPUs.
Ryzen AI provides seamless support for deploying original floating-point (FP32) models on NPU hardware through automatic conversion to BFLOAT16 (BF16) format.
